title: Triangle appears above Russian naval vessels off Kamchatka
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Triangle appears above Russian naval vessels off Kamchatka, about c. 2018 at Off Kamchatka, Russian Pacific, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Pacific Ocean off Kamchatka, eastern Russia

tellings.quote: we had a a surveillance asset uh in the ocean off the uh I believe was Kamchchatka but the the eastern seabboard of Russia in the in the Pacific
While they are observing the Russian vessels, a large black triangle materializes or decloaks or something.
tellings.difference: Told secondhand by Corbell, who says the triangle materialized or decloaked and gives no place (Kamchatka) or year.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of a large black triangle appearing above Russian naval vessels while they were being watched, from Matthew Brown and the Immaculate Constellation material.

as_told.title: Black triangle decloaks above Russian vessels

plain: A man described as a Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, says that around 2018 a US surveillance asset in the Pacific off Kamchatka, in far eastern Russia, was watching Russian navy ships when a large black triangle appeared above them, and that this is in a briefing for what he calls Immaculate Constellation, a secret government UFO program. Another guest, Jeremy Corbell, repeated Brown's account on the same podcast, saying the triangle "materializes or decloaks" but naming no place or year. If true, it would mean the US quietly records such craft near foreign forces.
